title: Apt.
sub: ROSÉ & Bruno Mars · cello arr. Glauco Fernandes
credit: Transcribed from the one-page Violoncello arrangement by Glauco Fernandes of Apt. (ROSÉ & Bruno Mars; Walter, Christopher Brody Brown, Chae Young Park, Nicholas Chinn, Theron Thomas, Rogét Chahayed, Omer). Single cello line, bass clef, in the left hand; the right hand rests. Repeats written out.
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, Bb3, C#5), chord [G4 Bb4 D5], rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1; fractions like 2/3 allowed). Prefix ~ = tied from the previous token of the same pitch (no new attack). Prefix / = rolled chord. Every bar must sum to 8 eighths.
_form: Printed bars 1-4 are repeated (indices 1-8), then printed 5-20 are indices 9-24, printed 21-24 are repeated (indices 25-32), and printed 25-33 are indices 33-41.

sections.name: Intro
sections.hint: The apateu chant: a C on the beat, C-C and C-Bb pairs off it, and back to C. Four bars, repeated; the fourth bar swaps the first pair for a rest and a single Bb. One line only, read in bass clef in the left hand — the right hand rests throughout.
sections.coach: One note and its neighbour. Keep the two eighth-note pairs even and land back on C.

sections.name: Verse
sections.hint: Eb and C trade places: Eb-Eb over a C, then a bar that holds the Eb across the beat with a tie, then a rest and seven straight Eb eighths. Bars 9-11 and 12-15 are two takes on the same idea.
sections.coach: Eb and C, then a run of even eighths after the rest. Count the rest — it starts the bar.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.hint: The line drops into the staff: Eb up to a dotted quarter, then Ab-Ab tied into G-G-G, a walk D-D-Eb-F, G into F. Bar 21 holds a half-note G. The second time round ends Bb-Eb-D-Eb into the chant.
sections.coach: Down into the staff now. The Ab-to-G figure ties over the beat — hold the Ab, no re-attack.

sections.name: Chant
sections.hint: The intro riff again, four bars repeated, exactly as before. A start repeat at printed bar 21 and an end repeat after printed bar 24.
sections.coach: The chant is back — same four bars twice. Steady eighths, no rush at 140.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.hint: Eb and D in even eighths, then Eb tied over the beat, a rest-Bb-C-Bb-C-rest answer, four Eb quarters, and a quarter rest before the run. Ends on the Ab-G figure from the pre-chorus.
sections.coach: Even eighths on Eb and D, then the tied Eb. The last bar is the Ab-G figure — end on the three Gs.
